title: Abstract Factory: related products
purpose: Show generic participants and two consistent product families.
alt: 클라이언트의 추상 팩토리·제품 의존과 두 구체 팩토리의 일관된 A/B 제품군
requiredChecks: Client uses AbstractFactory and AbstractProductA/AbstractProductB only.
AbstractFactory createProductA(): AbstractProductA and createProductB(): AbstractProductB are readable.
ConcreteFactory1 creates ProductA1/ProductB1; ConcreteFactory2 creates ProductA2/ProductB2.
Concrete factories implement AbstractFactory; concrete A/B products implement corresponding abstract A/B product; no client→concrete dependency.
prompt: Create a NEW original English raster technical diagram for a design-pattern study blog. White background, navy large sans-serif labels, flat blue and teal cards, spacious connectors, no copied slide layout or logos. Monospaced class/method identifiers. Distinguish uses, implements and creates via labels on directional connectors. Title "Abstract Factory: related products". TOP Client→AbstractFactory uses. Factory lists createProductA(): AbstractProductA, createProductB(): AbstractProductB. Top-right abstract product card lists AbstractProductA, AbstractProductB; Client→card uses. BELOW two family panels. ConcreteFactory1 implements AbstractFactory via upwards arrow; creates ProductA1 caption implements AbstractProductA and ProductB1 caption implements AbstractProductB via downwards branch. ConcreteFactory2 implements same factory; creates ProductA2 caption implements AbstractProductA and ProductB2 caption implements AbstractProductB. No client→concrete links, no mixed families. Footer "One factory supplies a consistent product family".
